$schema_note: Known virtual camera fingerprints used by Audit-VirtualCam.ps1. name_patterns are case-insensitive substrings matched against device friendly names; clsids are matched against DShow CLSIDs; named_sections are probed via OpenFileMappingW (V8); config_artifacts are filesystem paths with %APPDATA%/%LOCALAPPDATA% expansion (V9); metadata_patterns are matched against DLL VERSIONINFO fields and file names (V5). The static gate uses ONLY static_gate.patterns + static_gate.allowlist (canonical definition, phases 1/2/5 - do not narrow).

static_gate.definition: Canonical static gate (phase 1, normative for phases 2 and 5): locate the virtualcam DLL in the package by its CLSID resource (GUID 76692E1E-F28F-4DD6-9024-C3A999D30EFB); scan its VERSIONINFO string fields, its file name, its embedded UTF-8 and UTF-16 strings, and every zip entry name for the patterns below. A match is a violation unless the matched token is in the allowlist. Exit code 0 = pass.

allowlist.obs64.exe: OBS main executable self-detection: the virtualcam filter hides itself from OBS's own capture source list (virtualcam-filter.cpp); this string is required behavior, documented here per red-team adjudication.
